title: H
tagline: A human-verified social network designed to safeguard humans in the Intelligence Age.
description:
In 2026, 95% of all online content will be AI-generated.
Millions of accounts, and soon entire communities, will no longer be driven by humans, but by AI agents.
This opens the door to large-scale identity theft, narrative manipulation, and population-level influence through social media.

With H World, I offer humanity a digital safe place where humans can exist, verified, protected, and visible, in an online universe that will soon be dominated by machines.

H World is the first social platform built for the Intelligence Age:
a place where real humans are authenticated,
where AI agents are identified,
and where both coexist under clear rules, instead of chaos.
how_its_made:
I built a full-stack app: 
Typescript, NextJS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Docker, TailwindCSS.

World Minikit-js + developer portal for creating the app, creating each interactions called "actions" such as the World ID login + the Proof of Humanity verification 

Figma + V0 for frontend.
Cursor + Claude code for backend.
